name: UR-EY Player
summary:
UR-EY Player is a media player for watching the streams from your own playlist service on a big, resizable panel in Meta Quest, and on your phone, tablet and Android TV.

IMPORTANT: UR-EY Player does not include or sell any channels, movies, series or streams. You need an Xtream Codes account or an M3U playlist from a provider you are entitled to watch.

ONE ACCOUNT, EVERY SCREEN
• Sign in by scanning a code with your phone. No typing in the headset.
• Playlists, favorites and watch progress sync across all
